description: Renovate proposes pin moves; a person merges them. Nothing here merges on its own: the verify image decides what this mirror accepts, so a change to it is reviewed.

Pins stay pins: actions by commit hash with the version in a comment, images by digest under a '# tag: <tag>' marker. The repository requires SHA-pinned actions, and tests/static/50-workflow-policy.sh fails a change that turns one back into a tag.

packageRules.description: Actions move weekly in one pull request, and only to a release at least three days old, so a release that is pulled or hijacked upstream has time to be noticed before it lands here.

customManagers.description: An image pinned by digest under a '# tag: <tag>' marker: the verify image of each target, and the images the tests run in.
